{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, removing commas
# First, check for thousands separators
print("Unique revenue values (first 10):")
print(df['revenue'].unique()[:10])

# Replace commas and convert to float
df['revenue_numeric'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Check for QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
qa_orders = df[df['revenue_numeric'] == 999999.99]
print(f"Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}")

# Check for refunded orders
refunded = df[df['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {len(refunded)}")

# Filter: exclude QA and refunded orders
df_clean = df[(df['revenue_numeric'] != 999999.99) & (df['status'] == 'completed')]

# Group by channel and sum revenue
revenue_by_channel = df_clean.groupby('channel', as_index=False)['revenue_numeric'].sum()
print("Revenue by channel (cleaned):")
print(revenue_by_channel)

# Find the channel with the highest revenue
max_channel = revenue_by_channel.loc[revenue_by_channel['revenue_numeric'].idxmax()]['channel']
max_revenue = revenue_by_channel['revenue_numeric'].max()

print(f"Channel with most revenue: {max_channel} with {max_revenue:.2f} USD")"}
